items.title: JNJ or MRK: One Dividend Is Built to Last, One Faces a Reckoning
items.summary: Both JNJ and MRK have surged in 2026, but a looming patent cliff and a balance sheet loaded with acquisition debt mean one of these pharma dividends faces a reckoning that retirement investors cannot afford to ignore.

items.title: What Is The Options Market Telling Us About Eli Lilly Stock?
items.summary: Eli Lilly (LLY) management said on its second-quarter 2026 call that the price of Zepbound, its obesity drug, will go down. The company's sales growth rests on two drugs whose prices are falling - Zepbound and Mounjaro. That makes it difficult to call the stock's coming twelve months. So how do you really understand the risk you are taking with Eli Lilly stock? Well, you can look at the options market.

items.title: Moderna Climbs 3% Despite Citigroup’s Downgrade to Sell; BioNTech Inches Higher, Pfizer Treads Water
items.summary: Citigroup just told investors to sell Moderna and the stock responded by climbing 3%, raising one pointed question about whether pipeline optimism has fully broken free from Wall Street's valuation warnings.

items.title: Merck's Tulisokibart Meets Endpoints in Hidradenitis Suppurativa Study
items.summary: MRK's tulisokibart meets the phase IIb HS study's primary endpoint, with high and medium-dose regimens showing superiority over placebo at week 16.

items.title: Is A Cancer Vaccine Coming? Moderna, Merck Boosted By The Buzz
items.summary: Moderna stock rallied by triple digits when positive news rolled in for its cancer vaccine. But is mRNA ready to return to the limelight?

items.title: ABBV Stock Rises 25% in 6 Months: Time to Buy, Hold or Sell?
items.summary: AbbVie's stock climbs 25.4% in six months as Skyrizi, Rinvoq and neuroscience drugs fuel growth, but Humira erosion and competitive pressures remain.

items.title: Why Merck (MRK) Dipped More Than Broader Market Today
items.summary: In the latest trading session, Merck (MRK) closed at $145.31, marking a -2.66% move from the previous day.

items.title: Citi Downgrades Moderna Stock, Warning $80 Billion Valuation Asks Too Much of Cancer Pipeline
items.summary: Citi downgrades Moderna to Sell from Hold, saying the data around its cancer vaccine, instimeran autogene, isn’t enough to justify the valuation.
